blocks.text: Every day, teachers shape young minds, nurture dreams, and care for the next generation. This time, the care is for them. Recognizing educators as second parents and vital pillars of nation-building, International Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (IPI) continues to extend its commitment to wellness through its C.A.R.E. Kits Campaign (Championing Access to Wellness Resources for Educators). The initiative celebrates teachers whose dedication goes beyond the classroom, reminding them that those who give care deserve to receive it, too. Bringing trusted wellness solutions to educators Rolled out across selected schools in South Luzon and IPI’s five adopted schools in Cebu, the campaign forms part […]...
